rationale: The famous Manichaean numerical figure for the duration of the cosmic conflagration. ⲙⲛⲧ- numerical prefix + ⲁϥⲧⲉ̄ together yield 1468. This number is preserved across multiple Manichaean sources as the eschatological duration.
Greek loanword φορεῖν 'to bear, wear' with Coptic verbalizing prefix ⲣ̄-. Standard formation for Greek-derived verbs in Coptic.
Likely Lycopolitan reflex of ⲥⲉⲡⲉ/ⲥⲉⲉⲡⲉ 'remainder, what is left over.' Context: 'the Light is separated from the ⲥⲉⲧⲧⲉ of all things' — the residual matter remaining after extraction.
Compound ⲙⲁ- ('place of') + ⲡⲣⲉ/ⲏⲡⲣⲉ ('fruit'). The 'time of her fruit-bearing' = the harvest moment when the apostles, elect, and teachers proclaim. Cf. ⲡⲡⲣⲉ/ⲙ̄ⲡⲣⲉ 'fruit' in earlier vocabulary.
Possibly ϣⲙ̄ϣⲉ 'serve' or ϣⲙⲟⲩⲛ 'establish, abide.' Context: 'years they shall ϣⲙⲏⲛⲉ' = 'years they shall abide/remain.' Tentative.
Possibly Lycopolitan ⲱⲣⲁ 'measure, portion' (Crum). With 3pl possessive ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁ = 'their measure.' Alternative: ⲣⲁⲛ 'name' (ⲡⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛ 'their name').
